title: GridSim v1 protections.json
description: The placed protective devices of the case, one record each. Optional file; requires asset-classes.json. Member names are case-sensitive here (canonical camelCase spelling), although the v1 loader matches them ignoring case: the case editor refuses to save a non-canonical spelling until it is normalised (Q1, strict). Unknown members are refused, as the loader refuses them (R268). JSON null is refused everywhere: the loader reads null as absent, and the editor removes a member rather than writing null. Numeric ranges mirror the v2 network schema, so a v1 case the editor saves always projects to a valid v2 network. Rules a schema cannot express (bus references resolving, ZIP triples summing to 1, the [VERIFY] honesty rule) are the loader's.

protection.title: Protection
protection.description: A placed protective device (v1 ProtectionInstanceDto). Absent: name empty, capacityMw 0, no target branch.

class.title: Class
class.description: Name of a class of kind protection in asset-classes.json.

monitorBus.title: Monitored bus
monitorBus.description: The bus the device watches (must exist in buses.json).

capacityMw.title: Capacity (MW)
capacityMw.description: MW the device trips (infeed) or sheds (demand). Absent: 0.

targetBranch.title: Target branch
targetBranch.description: Branch a topology recloser acts on. Absent: none.
